changes.title: New API endpoint guarded by a permission: GET /api/bookkeeping/integration/options-sync
changes.risk_reason: New capability; confirm the guard matches the permission the PRD/story names.

plain.headline: New protected action: Viewing bookkeeping › integration › options sync
plain.what: There is a new action in the app (viewing bookkeeping › integration › options sync). Only people with “Settings — App”, “Settings — Data Import” and “Settings — Integrations” can use it.
plain.why: A new feature: make sure the right people can use it and nobody else can.
check: Log in as someone whose role has “Settings — App”, “Settings — Data Import” and “Settings — Integrations” and try it: it should work.
Log in as someone whose role has none of them and try it: it should be blocked, and the button or page should not be shown.

workflows: Screens/code: api/auth/AuthModel.ts, boot/axios.ts, components/office/ts/StaffDialog.vue, components/ts/administration/AdminLeftMenuNav.vue, components/ts/administration/WorkplaceDialog.vue, components/ts/navigation/ProfileMenu.vue (+10 more)
qa_scenarios: API authorisation: call GET /api/bookkeeping/integration/options-sync as a role WITH and a role WITHOUT "Settings — App" — expect 2xx and 403.
Front end: the matching screen action is shown only to roles the API allows (front end blocks + back end allows = pass; the reverse is a defect).
Cross-role: try the same call as each system role whose defaults include or exclude the permission.
